text.p: Scotsman Industries Inc said Wednesday its board authorized the redemption of all outstanding shares of the company's Series A $0.62 cumulative convertible preferred stock, par value $1 per share with a liquidation preference of $11.25 per share.
It said redemption of the 1,625,303 shares is set for October 25 at $11.76 per share plus accrued and unpaid dividends.
The convertible preferred stock receives an annual dividend of $0.62 per share. The current quarterly dividend rate on Scotsman's common stock has been $0.025 per share.

Conversion of all of the outstanding shares of convertible preferred stock would have no effect on Scotsman's reported fully diluted earnings per share and would save the company about $900,000 in after-tax cash dividends annually, it said.
